Ivy: heads-up eu-central rack9 showing intermittent p95 spikes since 14:05UTC. Symptoms: NIC interrupt storms + GPU thermal climb on host-9-05, co-tenants seeing degraded latency.
Carlos: pulling metrics now. host-9-05 irq_handler rates x6, nic_tx_queue_len ~180 for short bursts, gpu_temp climbing to 83C then throttle kicks.
Nina: Are these hosts running dedicated slices?
Carlos: Yes, two dedicated slices and one shared. Dedicated tenants: model-labs-ded & analytics-ingest. InfraBot alert suppressed auto-evict due to dedicated tag.
InfraBot: [alert] irq-storm@rack9 hosts=[host-9-05] duration=35s severity=medium auto_action=none reason=dedicated-slice
Ivy: Quick mitigation idea: move one noisy tenant to local warm-warmpool in same region and apply NIC shaping + GPU fan boost via firmware toggle to avoid thermal throttle. Non-disruptive if we preserve KV and local cache.
Nina: Fan boost sounds ok short-term. We should avoid cross-region handoffs due to egress cost. Use warmpool-euc1.
Carlos: Running move: `allocator move-tenant --tenant=model-labs-ded --to=warmpool-euc1 --preserve-kv --note "irq-storm mitigation"`
Carlos: Allocator: handoff accepted; warming KV on warmpool-euc1. Applying egress_shaper profile `soft-220mbit` and temporary cgroup cap.
Ivy: Applying firmware fan profile: `hwctl fan-profile --host host-9-05 --profile high-boost --duration 20m` to avoid GPU throttling.
LedgerBot: Notice: warmpool usage and firmware ops will be logged; estimated incremental cost ~+0.3 GPU-hrs. Billing event will be attached to tenant account.
Nina: After handoff + fan boost p95 on rack9 dropped from 410ms -> 95ms in ~90s. IRQ rates normalized and gpu_temp fell to 68C. Good recovery.
Carlos: Root cause: tenant started a nightly stress-run with a tight loop that caused large NIC bursts and prevented kernel IRQ mitigation from batching. We'll ask them to add pacing.
Ivy: Follow-ups: 1) add scheduler rule: if host irq_rate > 4x baseline and gpu_temp > 80C -> recommend soft-hand off to warmpool + optional fan boost. 2) add console hint showing estimated warmpool cost and opt-in for tenants on dedicated slices so infra can auto-suggest mitigation.
InfraBot: Created ticket INFRA-4012 (irq-storm mitigation + scheduler rule + console UX).
Nina: Keep the warmpool move active for 25m, notify tenant owners, then revert if stable.
Ivy: Thanks everyone. We'll add a short KB entry for tenant best-practices (pacing + backoff) and link from INFRA-4012 :thumbsup:
